study type: Secondary analysis of a cohort study
outcome: Composite of severe maternal outcomes (death, ICU admission, ventilator use, DVT/PE, sepsis, hemorrhage, DIC, unplanned operative procedure, or stroke)
finding: While super morbid obesity (BMI ≥ 50 kg/m2) was associated with an increased risk of severe maternal outcomes, this association was mediated by cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery appears to mediate the association between super morbid obesity and severe maternal outcomes, accounting for 46% of the risk.
